artifact.tree_hash_recipe: export LC_ALL=C; find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum

notes:
tree_hash_recipe corrected 2026-09-13 to name its locale. It was published without one, and a recipe without a locale does not pin a tree; it pins a tree and whatever locale the reader happens to have. Under en_US.UTF-8 the documented command yields 12a34ecb57ff16ac..., under the C locale f8ee075b149b2ac9... — different answers to the same question, because GNU sort ignores punctuation at the primary collation level there, so './bin/...' precedes './.claude-plugin/...' while the C locale orders the leading '.' (0x2E) first. Two orders, two permutations of the same sha256sum lines, two digests.

The asset bytes and artifact.tree_hash are unchanged and were never affected. f8ee075b149b2ac9... is what the product's own fingerprint() computes; the corrected recipe reproduces it under both locales, which is what makes it a recipe rather than a locale-specific observation.

The correction is on main only. Commit 7a74183 — the commit tag serveros-v1 names — still carries the locale-free text, because moving a tag is a force operation and this round does not do those. A reader at the tag should take the recipe from here or from the release body.

Found by running the documented command instead of trusting it: the publisher's own verify step passed the whole time, because it was running the recipe with LC_ALL=C injected — handing itself an environment the reader does not have.
